title: yTax response envelope
description: The envelope every operation response carries. Provenance is the payload: engine version, per-year dictionary content hash, input hash, integer-cent values, and per-line citations downstream. Same input_hash ⇒ byte-identical output.

engine_version.description: The pinned build tag/hash the result was computed by.

dictionary_hash.description: Content hash of dictionary/ty<year>/ at the pin.

input_hash.description: sha256 over the canonicalized fact set. Same input_hash ⇒ identical bytes.

result.description: Operation-specific; defined by each operation's response schema.

refusals.description: Structured refusals; each names the boundary and points at the coverage manifest.
